title: BARE HUD TEXT GETS THE OUTLINE
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD, where every word reads on any ground. The raid clock, the compass, the extraction lines above the belt, REVIVING, the Crier countdown and the party ping, Waypoint and arrow labels were filled with no outline and no plate, so over snow, a lit street or a fire they washed out. They now carry a thin dark ink outline, as the message rows have since v21.82, and the world prompts carry it on their plates too. The words, colours and places are unchanged, and no glow is used, for frame cost.
now: The raid clock, compass, extraction lines and party marks now have a dark outline, so they read over any ground.
